speaker: GRANDMA
text:
Happy birthday, love!!

I remember the day you were born like it was yesterday. Your mom and dad were over the moon.
And now you are 18. I still cannot believe it. A truly special day!
And on this day...
I'm giving you my car!

speaker: YOU
text:
Wait-what? Your car?
Grandma, you mean the Datsun out front??

speaker: GRANDMA
text:
Yes, love, the '71 Datsun 240Z, it originally belonged to my beloved sister...
It's yours now.

speaker: GRANDMA
text:
I'm sorry, love. Happy tears, mostly. She would have loved seeing you behind that wheel.

Now, off you go!
Take her out for a spin and please, stop by [POI] on [STREET] to pick up some maple syrup.
I'll make you pancakes this afternoon.
